The '''ion limpet''' or '''limpet''' was a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] used to track [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through space. It had a disc-like appearance and its thin profile helped prevent it from being detected. It utilized the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] to track spacecraft through the known galaxy.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a ion limpet. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] employed one in order to help the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] track the [[Teljkon Vagabond]].
